title: Coframe, which uses AI to make websites that test and personalize themselves for each visitor, raised a $25M Series A, bringing its total funding to $35M (Ben Bergman/Business Insider)
summary: Ben Bergman / Business Insider: Coframe, which uses AI to make websites that test and personalize themselves for each visitor, raised a $25M Series A, bringing its total funding to $35M — Billionaire venture capitalist Vinod Khosla is betting the days of one-size-fits-all websites are numbered.
